name: Breath of Belladonna
description: You consume a handful of belladonna berries. You take 1d4 damage from their poison, then exhale a poisonous cloud. Roll Spirit vs Fortitude against each creature within short range. On each win, the creature takes 3d10 damage. Half damage on a loss
successes:
✨: The creature is Weary for 1 round.

🌞: The creature must roll Fortitude against your original Spirit roll at the beginning of each of its turns. On each win, it takes 1d4 damage. On a loss, the effect ends.
